items.question: Multiplicity control for a pre-registered study with one primary test (H1) and two secondary tests (H2, H3). The study cannot run until each arm reaches n >= 100 (expected 2028), so power is not a constraint today.

options.label: (a)
options.text: H1 alone at alpha 0.05; H2 and H3 Holm at 0.05 as a secondary family (familywise error up to about 0.10 overall)

options.label: (b)
options.text: Holm across all three tests (familywise error capped at 0.05)

items.rationale: (b) caps the familywise error at 0.05 over all three. The only argument for (a) was power on the primary, and the run cannot open before n >= 100 in each arm anyway. (c) is uniformly weaker than (b) at the same guarantee.

items.question: A pre-registered liquidation-cluster x logged-OFI-flip study has only 28 events in 3 months of logged data: unreadable until about 2028. What now?

options.label: (a)
options.text: keep the OFI study sealed; re-count at each store refresh; run when each arm reaches 100

options.label: (a)+(e)
options.text: (a), plus a separate pre-registered study using trade-flow (aggressor imbalance) flips from the 21-month trade store, restricted to 2025-01-01 -> 2026-07-02 so the sealed OFI events stay outcome-blind

options.label: (b)
options.text: run now; every label NOT READABLE

options.label: (c)
options.text: redesign the OFI study for power now (lower threshold)

items.rationale: (a) keeps the OFI events outcome-blind. (e) gives a readable answer on a close cousin signal within weeks, from 18 months the OFI study can never use, without touching its sealed span. (b) is uninterpretable and unseals the span; (c) breaks the ruled thresholds; (d) discards a free accrual check.
